newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Dominion removed from list.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Dominion removed from list.

text.p: -- Furman Selz analysts Andrew Levi and Paul Patterson on Tuesday removed Dominion Resources Inc from the recommended list of stocks.
-- "A regulatory restructuring plan filed with the state of Virginia yesterday could lead to significantly lower earnings," they wrote in a report.
-- Dominion's rating was lowered to hold from buy.

-- "... Our new and reduced consolidated Dominion Resources estimates for 1997 and 1998 are $3.06 per share and $3.18 per share respectively, down from $3.40 per share and $3.60 per share respectively."
-- They set a 12- to 18-month price target of $36, down from the previous target of $42 to $44.
-- Shares in the Richmond, Va., utility opened on Tuesday down 5/8 at 37-1/8.
